records.name: Vesica Piscis
records.description: The precise Euclidean lens formed by two congruent circles whose centres are one radius apart. The archive records its construction, dimensions, mathematical derivation, historical uses and project-level symbolic interpretations.

records.name: Mandorla
records.description: An almond-shaped enclosure or aureole, closely related in visual form to the Vesica Piscis and historically important in sacred art, especially Christian iconography. The archive separates its geometry from its art-historical and symbolic meanings.
